recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-20567 unless a future terminology decision changes the SNOMED CT implicit ValueSet URL form.
issue_request: FHIR-20567 is a Published/Persuasive technical correction for FHIR-core ConceptMap/102. It reported that the Specimen v2 table 0487 to SNOMED CT ConceptMap used the invalid target ValueSet URI http://snomed.info/id?fhir_vs and requested http://snomed.info/sct?fhir_vs instead.
initial_application: No current-branch commit explicitly tagged FHIR-20567 was found. In current ancestry, commit 5db566a208601df59e6c725326554e94cdc68112 changed source/conceptmap/conceptmap-example-specimen-type.xml from the invalid targetCanonical value to http://snomed.info/sct?fhir_vs. Later ConceptMap refactors renamed targetCanonical to targetScopeCanonical without changing the corrected value.
additional_context: FHIR-23730 is a later same-change-family Published/Persuasive issue covering the same invalid SNOMED CT implicit ValueSet URL across example ConceptMaps, and it is already represented on the combined branch by commit e6990ec6a3ab00ee2a866fbcd065259351e5fceb. The originating Zulip thread records Michael Lawley's confirmation that http://snomed.info/id?fhir_vs is not a valid ValueSet URL and http://snomed.info/sct?fhir_vs is valid. The ConceptMap resource is active in source/fhir.ini, and ConceptMap/102 is listed in source/conceptmap/list-ConceptMap-examples.xml.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active current source for ConceptMap/102 already has <targetScopeCanonical value="http://snomed.info/sct?fhir_vs"/>, and no remaining tracked http://snomed.info/id?fhir_vs occurrence was found.
